verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a public REST API for creating integrations, retrieving data and automating workflows, plus a GraphQL API for precise queries. Both use fine-grained personal access tokens with documented per-endpoint permissions, and the X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions response header tells callers which permissions an endpoint needs. An llms.txt at docs.github.com also makes the docs machine-readable for AI-native users. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed docs paths (all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
